title: AI × Chem 每日精选
subtitle: 预印本、方法、数据集与实验验证的每日精选。
method: 公开来源采集、规则筛选与模型审阅
method_note: 系统保存当日公开元数据，依据频道主题与证据信号筛选候选，随后由指定模型阅读全文摘要并完成精选。

items.title: Systematic Benchmarking of AI-Based Molecular Generation Models for Structure-Based Drug Design
items.abstract_or_text: Generative artificial intelligence is accelerating molecular design, yet the relative suitability of available models for different targets and stages of preclinical drug discovery remains unclear. Here we benchmarked 12 molecular generation and optimization methods across 176 curated protein ligand systems spanning diverse therapeutic target classes, with experimentally validated ligands providing reference chemical space. The evaluated methods encompassed pocket conditioned 3D generation, diffusion and flow based modeling, autoregressive construction, reference conditioned optimization and synthesis-aware design. Performance was assessed using operational robustness, chemical validity, uniqueness, molecular and scaffold diversity, quantitative estimate of drug likeness, synthetic accessibility, docking, physicochemical and ADMET properties, and computational resource requirements. The results revealed architecture dependent trade off such as receptor conditioned methods exploited binding pocket geometry, flow based approaches enabled efficient sampling, reference-conditioned methods favored analogue generation, and synthesis-aware approaches improved chemical feasibility, but no method consistently optimized all criteria. To address the functional potential of generated molecules, we further developed a state aware functional classifier (SAFC) that integrates molecular dynamics derived receptor ensembles, ensemble docking and protein ligand interaction graphs. SAFC provided dynamics aware functional activity rankings for generated molecules that were partly complementary to docking, drug likeness and synthetic accessibility scores. These findings support hybrid, stage specific deployment of generative models rather than reliance on any single architecture or evaluation metric. This study provides practical guidelines for generative AI based preclinical drug development processes.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在176个经整理的蛋白—配体体系上比较12种分子生成与优化方法，并提出整合受体构象集合、集合对接和蛋白—配体相互作用图的SAFC功能分类器，用于对生成分子进行动力学感知的功能排序。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是面向结构药物设计的较大规模横向评测，明确显示不同架构各有适用情形，并为多指标、分阶段的模型组合提供依据。需注意其结论主要来自计算评估及参考化学空间，生成命中的真实活性和可合成性仍需逐靶点验证。
items.abstract_zh: 生成式人工智能正在加速分子设计，但现有模型对不同靶点和临床前药物发现不同阶段的相对适用性仍不清楚。本文在176个经整理的蛋白—配体体系上，对12种分子生成和优化方法进行了基准评测；这些体系覆盖多种治疗靶点类别，并以经实验验证的配体作为参考化学空间。所评估的方法包括口袋条件化3D生成、扩散和流模型、自回归构建、参考条件化优化以及合成感知设计。性能采用运行稳健性、化学有效性、唯一性、分子和骨架多样性、类药性定量估计、合成可及性、对接、理化和ADMET性质以及计算资源需求进行评估。结果揭示了依赖于架构的权衡：例如，受体条件化方法利用结合口袋几何信息，流方法能够高效采样，参考条件化方法更适于生成类似物，而合成感知方法提高了化学可行性，但没有任何一种方法能始终优化所有指标。为处理生成分子的功能潜力，我们还开发了状态感知功能分类器（SAFC），其整合了由分子动力学导出的受体构象集合、集合对接和蛋白—配体相互作用图。SAFC为生成分子提供了动力学感知的功能活性排序，与对接、类药性和合成可及性评分部分互补。这些发现支持在不同阶段混合部署生成模型，而不应依赖任何单一架构或评价指标。本研究为基于生成式AI的临床前药物开发流程提供了实用指南。
items.author_line: Kumar, H., Yang, Z., Yu, Y. 等 6 人

items.title: Superhuman Centaur Retrosynthesis Through Targeted LLM-enabled Decomposition in DeepRetro2
items.abstract_or_text: Retrosynthesis of complex molecules requires many chemically plausible transformations to be integrated into a coherent synthetic route. Although computational methods have improved reaction prediction and route identification, systematically decomposing complex molecules and coordinating multiple retrosynthetic steps remains challenging. Here we present DeepRetro2, an agentic retrosynthesis framework that extends large language model (LLM)-based retrosynthesis through recursive molecular decomposition, iterative generation, evaluation and expansion of retrosynthetic subproblems. DeepRetro2 enables autonomous retrosynthetic analysis for targets of moderate complexity, while substantially larger targets can be solved through a human-in-the-loop workflow in which expert 1 input is introduced at chemically critical decision points. We dub this mode of human-agentic collaboration “Centaur Retrosynthesis,” in homage to the tradition of human-AI “Centaur Chess.” We evaluated this framework on four chemically distinct targets: the unsolved ladder polyether maitotoxin (MTX), bryostatin 1, bryostatin 3 and luvesilocin. For MTX, DeepRetro2 generated a hierarchical decomposition into five major polyether fragments and subsequently elaborated these fragments into simpler synthons. For bryostatin 1 and bryostatin 3, it identified convergent fragment-level disconnections that preserved the stereochemically defined pyran frameworks, while luvesilocin provided a smaller-scale test of the same retrosynthetic framework. Across these targets, human-guided selection of protecting groups and functional-group transformations refined the computationally generated pathways, maintained orthogonal reactivity during fragment elaboration and facilitated chemically compatible fragment unions. DeepRetro2 therefore combines autonomous agentic retrosynthesis with expert-guided chemical reasoning, providing an iterative framework for decomposing complex molecular structures and developing chemically executable retrosynthetic pathways.
items.summary_zh: DeepRetro2将LLM逆合成与递归分子拆解、子问题迭代生成和人工化学判断结合，在maitotoxin、bryostatin 1、bryostatin 3和luvesilocin上构建了可逐步细化的合成拆解方案。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把复杂天然产物逆合成中的多步协调问题显式组织为可迭代任务，并保留化学家在保护基和官能团转换等关键选择中的作用。证据来自四个案例，尚缺少对路线可执行性、收率和实际全合成结果的系统检验。
items.abstract_zh: 复杂分子的逆合成需要将许多在化学上合理的转化整合为连贯的合成路线。尽管计算方法已经改善了反应预测和路线识别，但对复杂分子进行系统拆解并协调多个逆合成步骤仍具挑战。本文提出DeepRetro2，一种智能体式逆合成框架，它通过递归分子拆解、逆合成子问题的迭代生成、评估和扩展，扩展了基于大语言模型（LLM）的逆合成。DeepRetro2可对中等复杂度靶标进行自主逆合成分析；对于大得多的靶标，则可采用人在回路工作流，在化学关键决策点引入专家1输入。我们将这一人类—智能体协作模式称为“Centaur Retrosynthesis”，以致敬人机“Centaur Chess”的传统。我们在四个化学上不同的靶标上评估该框架：尚未解决的阶梯状聚醚maitotoxin（MTX）、bryostatin 1、bryostatin 3和luvesilocin。对于MTX，DeepRetro2生成了对五个主要聚醚片段的层级拆解，随后将这些片段细化为更简单的合成子。对于bryostatin 1和bryostatin 3，它识别出保留立体化学明确的吡喃骨架的汇聚式片段断键；而luvesilocin提供了同一逆合成框架的较小规模测试。在这些靶标中，人类指导的保护基和官能团转化选择细化了计算生成的路径，在片段细化过程中维持了正交反应性，并促进了化学相容的片段偶联。因此，DeepRetro2将自主智能体式逆合成与专家引导的化学推理结合，提供了一个用于拆解复杂分子结构并制定可在化学上实施的逆合成路径的迭代框架。
items.author_line: Sharanabasava D. Hiremath, Priyanka Makkar, Pramod Kumar 等 10 人

items.title: Resolution-standardized evaluation of ligand atomic coordinates in crystallographic structures using machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate assessment of ligand coordinate-density consistency across different resolutions remains challenging in macromolecular crystallography. We introduce the atomic Box Correlation Coefficient (aBCC), an atom-level metric for evaluating the consistency between ligand atomic coordinates and electron density in a resolution-standardized framework. To predict aBCC values from electron-density maps, we developed QAEmap, a machine learning model based on three-dimensional convolutional neural networks (3D-CNNs). The model was trained using Fourier-truncated electron-density maps and corresponding ligand coordinates generated from high-resolution structures in the Protein Data Bank. It was evaluated using both Fourier-truncated electron-density maps and experimentally determined PDB structures. was evaluated using both Fourier-truncated electron-density maps and experimentally determined PDB structures.The prediction accuracy gradually decreased with decreasing resolution, but remained reliable up to ~3.5 angstrom. These results demonstrate that aBCC enables resolution-standardized atom-wise evaluation of coordinate-density consistency across different resolutions and provide a foundation for further development and refinement of machine learning-based coordinate validation.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出原子级Box Correlation Coefficient（aBCC）及3D-CNN模型QAEmap，以分辨率标准化方式评价晶体结构中配体原子坐标与电子密度的一致性；在约3.5 Å以内预测仍可靠。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 配体构象质量直接影响结构基础药物设计的训练数据和结构解释。该工作提供原子粒度的验证思路；但随着分辨率降低准确度下降，且模型训练和验证依赖PDB结构，跨实验条件的泛化仍待评估。
items.abstract_zh: 在大分子晶体学中，准确评估不同分辨率下配体坐标与密度的一致性仍具挑战。我们引入原子级Box Correlation Coefficient（aBCC），一种在分辨率标准化框架内评估配体原子坐标与电子密度一致性的原子级指标。为从电子密度图预测aBCC值，我们开发了基于三维卷积神经网络（3D-CNN）的机器学习模型QAEmap。该模型采用由Protein Data Bank高分辨率结构生成的傅里叶截断电子密度图及相应配体坐标训练。它同时采用傅里叶截断电子密度图和实验测定的PDB结构进行评估。它同时采用傅里叶截断电子密度图和实验测定的PDB结构进行评估。预测准确度随分辨率降低而逐渐下降，但在约3.5 angstrom以内仍保持可靠。这些结果表明，aBCC能够以分辨率标准化方式逐原子评估坐标—密度一致性，并为进一步开发和完善基于机器学习的坐标验证提供基础。
items.author_line: Miyaguchi, I., Hata, H., Kuribayashi, T. 等 10 人

items.title: Discovery of Selective Small-Molecule Ligands of SV2C by AI-Enhanced Virtual Screening and Experimental Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Synaptic vesicle glycoprotein 2C (SV2C) is a vesicular protein enriched in dopaminergic neurons of the basal ganglia that modulates dopamine storage and release, and its disruption is implicated in Parkinson's disease (PD). Despite strong genetic and pathological links to PD, there are no selective small-molecule probes for SV2C. Here, we describe an AI-enhanced virtual screening (VS) and experimental campaign that identified multiple novel chemotypes with low-micromolar affinity and marked selectivity for SV2C over SV2A and SV2B, starting from a large, general-purpose commercial library. Because no full-length high-resolution SV2C structure was available, we built a homology model using SV2A cryo-EM structures as templates and characterized its conformational landscape by molecular dynamics (MD) and Gaussian accelerated MD (GaMD) simulations in apo form and in complex with known SV2 ligands (plosaracetam, levetiracetam, brivaracetam, and padsevonil). A convolutional neural network-based scoring function (CNN_VS), retrospectively validated on a manually curated 39-ligand SV2A benchmark (r = 0.72 vs experimental pIC50), was then applied in a multi-stage funnel to 5.96 million Mcule in-stock compounds, which were sequentially filtered to 3.19 million CNS-relevant molecules before docking and rescoring. From 94 VS-prioritized candidates, 71 compounds were experimentally profiled in an orthogonal primary assay cascade combining a thermal shift assay (TSA) with a [3H]-padsevonil scintillation proximity assay (SPA), followed by Ki determination and isoform selectivity profiling for key hits. This campaign yielded 22 active molecules (31% hit rate) that naturally segregated into two categories: compounds that showed primary site competition, and compounds that did not show primary site competition with [3H]-padsevonil. A subset of competitor compounds also showed thermostabilization activity. Among these, compounds 36 and 56 emerged as particularly attractive leads, with Ki values of 24.6 uM and 3.25 uM at SV2C, respectively, and greater than 10-fold selectivity versus SV2A; compound 56 also maintained approximately 12-fold selectivity relative to SV2B. A complementary subset of SV2C-selective hits behaved as padsevonil-site competitors, providing a lead set that will serve as a template for functional characterization and future drug development for conditions that affect dopaminergic signaling. Docking analysis suggests a common binding mode anchored by conserved tryptophan residues in the SV2 pocket, a prediction independently confirmed by an unpublished SV2A-plosaracetam cryo-EM structure showing 0.76 Angstrom binding-site C-alpha RMSD relative to the SV2C model and complete conservation of the tryptophan cage. Subtle differences in the luminal domain and transmembrane region point to the structural determinants underlying isoform selectivity. Collectively, these results demonstrate that an AI-driven VS pipeline, tightly integrated with medium-throughput biophysical assays, can deliver selective SV2C binders from a general chemical library on a structurally under-characterized membrane target. The identified hits provide multiple starting points for hit-to-lead optimization and tools for probing SV2C biology and its role in PD.
items.summary_zh: 该工作以SV2A冷冻电镜结构建立SV2C同源模型，经MD/GaMD、CNN_VS虚拟筛选和正交生物物理实验，从596万种商业化合物中发现22个SV2C活性分子；其中化合物56对SV2C的Ki为3.25 uM，并相对SV2A和SV2B保持选择性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在缺少全长高分辨率靶标结构的条件下，工作展示了AI筛选与实验测定结合可产出选择性先导物。限制在于命中物仍为低微摩尔级，结合模式部分基于同源建模和未发表结构，功能药理与体内研究尚未给出。
items.abstract_zh: 突触囊泡糖蛋白2C（SV2C）是一种富集于基底神经节多巴胺能神经元的囊泡蛋白，调节多巴胺储存和释放；其功能紊乱与Parkinson's disease（PD）有关。尽管其与PD有很强的遗传和病理关联，目前尚无SV2C选择性小分子探针。本文描述了一项AI增强的虚拟筛选（VS）和实验研究：从大型通用商业库出发，鉴定出多个新颖化学型，它们对SV2C具有低微摩尔亲和力，并相对于SV2A和SV2B表现出显著选择性。由于没有全长高分辨率SV2C结构，我们以SV2A cryo-EM结构为模板建立同源模型，并通过分子动力学（MD）和Gaussian accelerated MD（GaMD）模拟，在游离态以及与已知SV2配体（plosaracetam、levetiracetam、brivaracetam和padsevonil）形成复合物时表征其构象景观。随后，基于卷积神经网络的评分函数（CNN_VS）在一个人工整理的39配体SV2A基准上进行回顾性验证（r = 0.72，相对于实验pIC50），并在多阶段漏斗中应用于596万种Mcule现货化合物；这些化合物在对接和重评分前被依次筛至319万种与CNS相关的分子。在94个VS优选候选物中，71个化合物接受了正交初筛实验级联评估，结合热转变实验（TSA）和[3H]-padsevonil闪烁邻近实验（SPA），随后对关键命中物测定Ki并进行同工型选择性分析。该研究获得22个活性分子（31%命中率），它们自然分为两类：表现出主位点竞争的化合物，以及不与[3H]-padsevonil发生主位点竞争的化合物。一部分竞争性化合物还表现出热稳定化活性。其中，化合物36和56是特别有吸引力的先导物，其在SV2C上的Ki分别为24.6 uM和3.25 uM，并且相对于SV2A具有超过10倍的选择性；化合物56相对于SV2B也维持约12倍选择性。一组补充性的SV2C选择性命中物表现为padsevonil位点竞争者，提供了一组可用于功能表征和未来药物开发的先导物模板，服务于影响多巴胺能信号的疾病。对接分析提示一种由SV2口袋保守色氨酸残基锚定的共同结合模式；一项未发表的SV2A-plosaracetam cryo-EM结构独立证实了这一预测：相对于SV2C模型，其结合位点C-alpha RMSD为0.76 Angstrom，且色氨酸笼完全保守。腔内结构域和跨膜区的细微差异提示了同工型选择性背后的结构决定因素。总体而言，这些结果表明，紧密整合中通量生物物理实验的AI驱动VS流程，可从通用化学库中为结构表征不足的膜靶标获得选择性SV2C结合物。所鉴定的命中物为命中至先导优化提供多个起点，也可作为研究SV2C生物学及其在PD中作用的工具。
items.author_line: Brueckner, A. C., Martin, M. F., Khuttan, S. 等 12 人

items.title: RetroMPA: A Molecular Property-Aware Auxiliary Framework for Enhancing Retrosynthesis Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Retrosynthesis is a cornerstone of drug discovery and organic synthesis. While data-driven deep learning models have shown remarkable progress, they autonomously learn reaction patterns from extensive datasets with limited integration of established chemical knowledge as priors. To address this limitation, we introduce RetroMPA, a molecular property-aware, post-hoc enhancement module that injects chemical knowledge into the retrosynthesis pipeline. Rather than functioning as an independent SMILES sequence generator, RetroMPA is a broadly applicable, model-agnostic chemical filter designed to recalibrate and optimize the predictive pathways of existing algorithms. This plug-and-play framework integrates seamlessly with a range of data-driven retrosynthesis methods, enhancing outputs without modifying model architecture or requiring resource-intensive retraining. By leveraging a property-aware latent embedding space, RetroMPA consistently improves top-1 accuracy across eight representative retrosynthesis models by an average of 5.50% on USPTO-50K. Furthermore, we validate its scalability on the large-scale USPTO-Full dataset, achieving an average improvement of about 2.03% across both template-based and template-free architectures. Wet-lab experiments provide preliminary support for the practical utility of the framework. These syntheses confirmed viable, previously unreported substrate combinations for classic reaction paradigms---specifically, Suzuki-Miyaura coupling, Bucherer reaction, and Friedel-Crafts acylation---suggesting that RetroMPA can operate beyond mere data fitting. The code is open-sourced at https://github.com/MengzhouLu/RetroMPA.
items.summary_zh: RetroMPA是可插拔、与原模型无关的逆合成后处理模块，通过分子性质感知的潜在表示校正预测路径；它在USPTO-50K上使八种模型的top-1准确率平均提高5.50%，并以三类经典反应的湿实验支持实用性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法无需重训即可向多种逆合成器引入化学先验，并报告了跨数据集和湿实验结果。其增益仍以USPTO数据集指标为主，实验仅提供初步支持，尚需更广泛的复杂底物和路线级验证。
items.abstract_zh: 逆合成是药物发现和有机合成的基石。尽管数据驱动的深度学习模型已取得显著进展，但它们从大规模数据集中自主学习反应模式，对既有化学知识作为先验的整合有限。为解决这一局限，我们提出RetroMPA，一种分子性质感知的事后增强模块，可将化学知识注入逆合成流程。RetroMPA并不作为独立的SMILES序列生成器，而是一种广泛适用、与模型无关的化学过滤器，旨在重新校准并优化现有算法的预测路径。这一即插即用框架可与一系列数据驱动逆合成方法无缝整合，在不改变模型架构或不需要资源密集型重新训练的情况下增强输出。借助性质感知的潜在嵌入空间，RetroMPA在USPTO-50K上使八种代表性逆合成模型的top-1准确率平均持续提高5.50%。此外，我们在大规模USPTO-Full数据集上验证其可扩展性，在基于模板和无模板架构中均实现约2.03%的平均提升。湿实验为该框架的实际效用提供了初步支持。这些合成证实了经典反应范式中可行、此前未报道的底物组合——具体为Suzuki-Miyaura coupling、Bucherer reaction和Friedel-Crafts acylation——提示RetroMPA的作用超出单纯的数据拟合。代码已在https://github.com/MengzhouLu/RetroMPA开源。
items.author_line: Mianzhi Liu, Fan Xiao, Zhiliang Yu 等 8 人

items.title: Integrating Multi-Task Surrogate Modelling with Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous CO2 Reduction Catalyst Discovery: A Proof-of-Concept Framework
items.abstract_or_text: Computational design of heterogeneous catalysts for CO2 reduction remains constrained by the prohibitive cost of density functional theory (DFT) calculations and the vast compositional search space of transition-metal alloys. We present a proof-of-concept framework that integrates three AI components: (i) a multi-task neural network surrogate trained on physics-informed synthetic data that simultaneously predicts activation energy (R2 = 0.984), turnover frequency (R2 = 0.984), selectivity (R2 = 0.974), and stability (R2 = 0.559); (ii) a proximal policy optimisation (PPO) agent that autonomously navigates an 18-dimensional action space of metal–facet–alloy compo-sitions, identifying Fe(111) as the top-ranked catalyst within the synthetic model (TOF = 103.93 s−1, selectivity = 0.72); and (iii) an explainability pipeline (SHAP, learned attention, counterfactuals) that recovers the dband centre as the dominant descriptor—providing an internal-consistency check on the physics encoded in the data generator. All synthetic targets are grounded in established computational catalysis models: Sabatierprinciple volcano curves, Brønsted–Evans–Polanyi rela-tions, and a dual-volcano competitive-kinetics selectivity model for CO2RR versus HER. We discuss the frame-work’s limitations—including the discrepancy between our synthetic prediction and experimental Faradaic-efficiency trends—with full transparency and propose a path toward DFT-validated deployment.
items.summary_zh: 该概念验证框架以物理启发的合成数据训练多任务神经网络代理模型，再由PPO智能体在18维金属—晶面—合金空间中搜索CO2还原催化剂，并以SHAP、注意力和反事实分析解释描述符作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作将代理建模、强化学习与可解释性整合到催化剂搜索，且作者明确承认合成预测与实验Faradaic效率趋势不符。结果尚未得到DFT或实验验证，因此当前价值主要在于提出可检验的流程。
items.abstract_zh: 用于CO2还原的多相催化剂计算设计，仍受制于密度泛函理论（DFT）计算的高昂成本以及过渡金属合金庞大的组成搜索空间。我们提出一个概念验证框架，整合三个AI组件：（i）在物理启发合成数据上训练的多任务神经网络代理模型，同时预测活化能（R2 = 0.984）、周转频率（R2 = 0.984）、选择性（R2 = 0.974）和稳定性（R2 = 0.559）；（ii）一个proximal policy optimisation（PPO）智能体，在金属—晶面—合金组成的18维动作空间中自主导航，在合成模型内将Fe(111)识别为排名第一的催化剂（TOF = 103.93 s−1，选择性 = 0.72）；以及（iii）一个可解释性流程（SHAP、学习到的注意力、反事实），它恢复d band centre为主导描述符，从而对数据生成器中编码的物理提供内部一致性检验。所有合成靶标都以既有计算催化模型为基础：Sabatier principle volcano curves、Brønsted–Evans–Polanyi relations，以及用于CO2RR与HER的dual-volcano competitive-kinetics选择性模型。我们以完全透明的方式讨论该框架的局限性——包括合成预测与实验Faradaic-efficiency趋势之间的差异——并提出通向经DFT验证部署的路径。

items.title: Crystal-structure design by agentic AI in a language of motifs
items.abstract_or_text: Data-driven materials discovery interpolates more reliably than it extrapolates and seldom reaches new structure types. We present MatEvolve, an agentic-AI framework designing crystals, proposing each candidate with a stated rationale and testing it. The agent reasons in an interpretable language of motifs, writing each crystal as a motif profile that describes the recurring geometric patterns---the motifs---composing it. The motif profile serves not merely as a description of a material but as the medium for material design: the agent edits the profile and constructs a crystal from the modified one, and the most promising candidates are validated by first-principles calculation. Applied to the design of rare-earth-lean permanent magnets, MatEvolve---built on the state-of-the-art language model Claude Fable~5 without fine-tuning---reaches new structural prototypes more than three times as often as generative models under an equal validation budget, at a comparable on-target-magnet rate. Beyond design, analysing the discovered crystals' human-readable profiles reveals structure--property relationships.
items.summary_zh: MatEvolve以可读的结构母题描述晶体，令智能体修改母题画像、构建候选晶体并用第一性原理计算验证；在稀土低用量永磁体设计中，其发现新结构原型的频率超过同等验证预算下生成模型的三倍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将可解释的晶体结构表征直接用于智能体式设计，并用第一性原理计算筛选，适合探索训练分布外材料。其结论基于计算验证及单一应用场景，候选材料的可合成性和实验磁性能尚待确认。
items.abstract_zh: 数据驱动的材料发现插值通常比外推更可靠，也很少触及新的结构类型。我们提出MatEvolve，一个设计晶体的智能体式AI框架；它为每个候选物提出带有明确理由的方案并进行测试。该智能体以一种可解释的母题语言推理，将每种晶体写为母题画像，描述构成该晶体的反复出现几何模式——即母题。母题画像不仅是材料的描述，也是材料设计的媒介：智能体编辑该画像并从修改后的画像构建晶体，最有前景的候选物由第一性原理计算验证。应用于稀土低用量永磁体设计时，MatEvolve——以最先进语言模型Claude Fable~5构建且未经微调——在相同验证预算下发现新结构原型的频率超过生成模型三倍，同时靶向磁体命中率相当。除设计之外，对所发现晶体的人类可读画像进行分析还揭示了结构—性质关系。
items.author_line: Dinh-Khiet Le, Minh-Quyet Ha, Hong-Phuc Vu-Dinh 等 6 人

items.title: A contextualised protein language model reveals the functional syntax of bacterial evolution
items.abstract_or_text: Bacteria have evolved a vast diversity of functions and behaviours that are currently incompletely understood and poorly predicted from DNA sequence alone. To understand the syntax of bacterial evolution and discover genome-to-phenotype relationships, we curated over 1.3 million genomes spanning bacterial phylogenetic space, represented each as an ordered sequence of proteins, and used these sequences to train a transformer-based, contextualised protein language model, Bacformer. By pretraining on genome-wide evolutionary patterns, Bacformer captures the compositional and positional relationships of proteins and thereby provides a whole-genome framework for linking genomic organisation and content to measurable bacterial traits. We demonstrate the ability of Bacformer to accurately predict protein-protein interactions; uncover operon structure, which we validated experimentally; infer important phenotypic traits, including antimicrobial resistance, while revealing likely causal genes; and design template synthetic proteomes with desirable properties. Thus, Bacformer establishes a genomic foundation model that reveals the evolutionary rules governing bacterial gene organisation, function, and phenotype, opening a route to systematic whole-genome engineering.
items.summary_zh: Bacformer以130多万个细菌基因组的有序蛋白质序列训练上下文化蛋白语言模型，可预测蛋白—蛋白相互作用、识别经实验验证的操纵子结构、推断抗菌药物耐药性相关基因，并设计具有目标性质的合成蛋白质组模板。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把蛋白序列语境扩展至全基因组组织，连接细菌进化、基因组结构和表型，对合成生物学具有潜在价值。训练数据覆盖及实验验证令人关注，但表型因果解释和设计蛋白质组在真实菌株中的可行性仍需更充分验证。
items.abstract_zh: 细菌已演化出目前尚未被完全理解、也难以仅从DNA序列预测的巨大功能和行为多样性。为理解细菌进化的语法并发现基因组到表型的关系，我们整理了覆盖细菌系统发育空间的130多万个基因组，将每个基因组表示为有序的蛋白质序列，并利用这些序列训练了基于Transformer的上下文化蛋白语言模型Bacformer。通过在全基因组尺度的进化模式上预训练，Bacformer捕捉蛋白质的组成和位置关系，从而提供将基因组组织和内容与可测量细菌性状联系起来的全基因组框架。我们展示了Bacformer准确预测蛋白—蛋白相互作用的能力；发现操纵子结构，并对此进行了实验验证；推断包括抗菌药物耐药性在内的重要表型，同时揭示可能的因果基因；以及设计具有理想性质的模板合成蛋白质组。因此，Bacformer建立了一个基因组基础模型，揭示控制细菌基因组织、功能和表型的进化规律，为系统性全基因组工程开辟了路径。
items.author_line: Wiatrak, M., Abelson, D. C., Mikhaylenko, R. 等 12 人

items.title: Modality-chain reasoning enables multimodal protein modelling and design
items.abstract_or_text: Reasoning has emerged as a central capability of large language models, yet how it should be formulated for scientific foundation models remains unclear because scientific knowledge is distributed across interdependent, domain-specific representations. Here we introduce modality-chain reasoning, which organizes representations into ordered computational chains, each conditioning prediction or generation of the next. Based on this principle, we develop ProteinReasoner, a multimodal generative protein foundation model that sequentially connects amino acid sequence, evolutionary constraints and three-dimensional structure within a shared autoregressive architecture. Across zero-shot structure prediction, inverse folding and fitness prediction, ProteinReasoner outperformed two multimodal protein foundation models, while controlled comparisons supported the functional contribution of the modality chain. We further extended this principle beyond pretraining: reorganizing the chain across successive structural states enabled multiple-conformation prediction, while introducing experimental feedback as an additional modality enabled an in-context learning paradigm for protein optimization without target-specific parameter updates. In particular, across thermostability and affinity-maturation evaluations, this paradigm improved over matched fine-tuned models and showed stronger mean performance than target-specific active-learning baselines. These results establish modality-chain reasoning as a unified and effective foundation-modelling strategy in protein science. More broadly, they suggest a general route towards reasoning across interdependent representations in other scientific domains.
items.summary_zh: ProteinReasoner将氨基酸序列、进化约束和三维结构按顺序连接，在零样本结构预测、逆折叠和适应度预测中优于两种多模态蛋白基础模型；进一步通过结构状态和实验反馈支持多构象预测及无需靶标微调的蛋白优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作提出了把科学对象的关联表征组织为推理序列的通用思路，并在蛋白稳定性和亲和力成熟任务中给出比较。结果主要是模型评测，实验反馈的来源、适用靶标范围和候选蛋白的湿实验成功率仍需审慎考察。
items.abstract_zh: 推理已成为大语言模型的一项核心能力，但由于科学知识分布在相互依赖、特定领域的表征之中，尚不清楚应如何为科学基础模型构建推理。本文提出模态链推理，它将表征组织为有序的计算链，每一步都对下一步的预测或生成施加条件。基于这一原则，我们开发ProteinReasoner，一个多模态生成式蛋白质基础模型，它在共享的自回归架构中依次连接氨基酸序列、进化约束和三维结构。在零样本结构预测、逆折叠和适应度预测中，ProteinReasoner优于两个多模态蛋白质基础模型，受控比较支持模态链的功能贡献。我们还将这一原则扩展至预训练之外：跨连续结构状态重组该链，实现了多构象预测；而将实验反馈引入为额外模态，则实现了一种无需靶标特异参数更新的、用于蛋白质优化的上下文学习范式。特别是，在热稳定性和亲和力成熟评估中，这一范式优于匹配的微调模型，并显示出强于靶标特异主动学习基线的平均性能。这些结果确立了模态链推理作为蛋白质科学中统一且有效的基础建模策略。更广泛地说，它们提示了在其他科学领域中跨相互依赖表征进行推理的一条通路。
items.author_line: Liu, C., Chao, L., Ji, S. 等 14 人

items.title: LASSBio-classFLOW: A Semi-Automated KNIME Workflow for Classification Model Benchmarking and Virtual Screening
creators: Bárbara da Silva Mascarenhas de Jesus
items.abstract_or_text: Machine learning–based quantitative structure–activity relationship (ML-QSAR) modeling requires consistent data preparation, validation, and model comparison. We present LASSBio-classFLOW, an open, modular, and semi-automated KNIME workflow for classification-based ligand screening. It integrates basic molecular structure preparation, configurable class assignment, descriptors and fingerprints calculation, dataset partitioning, hyperparameter optimization of nine algorithms, interactive performance evaluation, user-guided model selection, and external-library prediction. As an example, the workflow was evaluated using 1,408 ROCK2 compounds from ChEMBL (218 active and 1,190 inactive). Models were trained and optimized by five-fold crossvalidation and evaluated on a held-out 20% test set. Support vector machine (SVM) and k-nearest neighbors (kNN) provided the most consistent results across both stages. On the held-out set, SVM favored active-class precision (0.861), whereas kNN achieved higher active recall (0.750). LASSBio-classFLOW (available at https://github.com/pedrosenamp/LASSBio-classFLOW_v1.0.git) therefore provides a transparent, reusable environment for benchmarking, comparative ML-QSAR development and flexible deployment, while preserving user control over model selection and screening decisions.
items.summary_zh: LASSBio-classFLOW是开放、模块化的KNIME分类QSAR工作流，覆盖结构准备、特征计算、数据划分、九种算法的优化与外部库预测；在1408个ROCK2化合物案例中，SVM和kNN在留出集上表现最稳定。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将常被分散处理的QSAR建模步骤整理为可复用且保留用户选择的流程，有利于透明比较模型。演示数据集中活性类别不平衡，且目前仅展示单一靶标，跨靶标的稳健性和筛选前瞻命中率尚未得到证明。
items.abstract_zh: 基于机器学习的定量构效关系（ML-QSAR）建模需要一致的数据准备、验证和模型比较。我们提出LASSBio-classFLOW，一个开放、模块化、半自动的基于KNIME的分类配体筛选工作流。它整合基本分子结构准备、可配置的类别分配、描述符和指纹计算、数据集划分、九种算法的超参数优化、交互式性能评估、用户引导的模型选择及外部文库预测。作为示例，该工作流采用来自ChEMBL的1,408个ROCK2化合物进行评估（218个活性化合物和1,190个非活性化合物）。模型通过五折交叉验证训练和优化，并在留出的20%测试集上评估。支持向量机（SVM）和k近邻（kNN）在两个阶段均给出最一致的结果。在留出集上，SVM具有更高的活性类别精确率（0.861），而kNN实现了更高的活性召回率（0.750）。因此，LASSBio-classFLOW（可在https://github.com/pedrosenamp/LASSBio-classFLOW_v1.0.git获取）提供了透明、可复用的环境，用于基准测试、比较性ML-QSAR开发和灵活部署，同时保留用户对模型选择和筛选决策的控制。
items.author_line: Pedro de Sena Murteira Pinheiro, Jefferson Muniz Alves da Silva, Bárbara da Silva Mascarenhas de Jesus 等 5 人

items.title: PROBE: An Executable Physics-Validation Benchmark for LLM-Generated Process Model Code
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as assistants for chemical process modeling, yet existing benchmarks grade them with LLM judges, which are lenient and not reproducible. We introduce PROBE, an executable benchmark that scores LLM-generated first-principles process models objectively, and report an initial pilot study across ten reference tasks. PROBE evaluates contract-bound implementation—turning a specified model into correct, simulable code under a fixed input/output contract—rather than unconstrained model formulation from an underspecified engineering description. Each generated model is checked on five levels—runnability, dimensional consistency (units), structural correctness against a reference derivative field, physical invariants (mass/energy conservation, boundary and limit behavior), and numerical agreement with a reference simulation—with no LLM judges. The benchmark spans ordinary-differential problems (reactors with mass and energy balances), a differentialalgebraic problem (vapor–liquid flash / MESH equations), and a coupled multi-unit flowsheet with recycle. The benchmark comprises ten problems: six canonical textbook unit operations, a harder tier (a method-of-lines plug-flow reactor, i.e. a distributed-parameter PDE; the Van de Vusse multiple-reaction network; and a non-ideal flash with NRTL activity coefficients), and one procedurally generated reaction network that appears in no textbook. All models—frontier and local—are evaluated under one protocol: a single prompt, no tools, no iterative revision, five samples each. Two findings emerge. First, within the scope of PROBE the three Claude models (Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, and the low-cost Haiku 4.5) are strikingly reliable: across all ten problems we observed no failure in 150 generations (50 each), an upper 95% bound of ≈ 2% on the pergeneration failure rate by the rule of three—under a pooled Bernoulli interpretation restricted to this evaluated mixture of models and tasks, not a rate to be generalized to unseen processmodeling problems. This holds on the harder tier and on the procedurally generated network alike, and—notably—the inexpensive Haiku 4.5 is as reliable as the flagship models, so frontiergrade performance on these tasks is available at a low-cost tier. Google Gemini 2.5 Flash is near-ceiling as well, dipping only on the non-ideal NRTL flash and on a reproducible parameternaming slip, so the reliability spans two vendors. This is not what judge-based benchmarks report, and the novel-network result argues against mere memorization. We are careful not to claim that LLMs have “solved” process modeling: the evidence is that, on first-principles unit operations with a fixed input/output contract, current frontier models rarely make physics errors—not a statement about full industrial flowsheets or free-form modeling. Second, the correctness gap is concentrated in smaller, locally deployable models (3–14 B), whose outputs are moreover highly stochastic. While a physics-validation feedback loop can produce striking within-conversation repairs, at a matched generation budget we found no evidence, in this limited experiment, that it outperforms simply resampling and keeping the best-scoring candidate (paired Wilcoxon signed-rank: no significant difference). That comparison is made essential by the same stochasticity, which also renders single-run evaluations of such loops misleading. In one controlled comparison, adding a reasoning trace did not close the gap either: a single samesize open reasoning model lifted the mean only marginally over its non-reasoning counterpart, still failed the flash on the identical contract-naming slip, and on some hard problems reasoned past a large token budget without ever emitting an answer—consistent with capability, rather than the amount of feedback or inference-time computation, being the binding constraint on these models.
items.summary_zh: PROBE以可执行的物理验证评价LLM生成的化工过程模型代码，检查可运行性、单位一致性、结构正确性、物理不变量和数值一致性。在十项任务试验中，三种Claude模型的150次生成均未失败，但小型本地模型仍存在显著差距。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 相较由LLM裁判的评测，PROBE给出更可复现的过程模型正确性标准，并清楚限定了测试合同。数据规模仅十题、模型调用无工具且无迭代，不能据此推及自由形式建模或工业级全流程设计。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）日益被提议作为化学过程建模助手，但现有基准采用LLM裁判评分，较为宽松且不可复现。我们引入PROBE，一个以客观方式为LLM生成的第一性原理过程模型评分的可执行基准，并报告了涵盖十项参考任务的初步试验研究。PROBE评估受契约约束的实现——在固定输入/输出契约下将指定模型转化为正确、可模拟的代码——而不评估从欠明确工程描述中自由构建模型。每个生成模型在五个层面接受检验：可运行性、量纲一致性（单位）、相对于参考导数场的结构正确性、物理不变量（质量/能量守恒、边界和极限行为）以及与参考模拟的数值一致性；不使用LLM裁判。该基准涵盖常微分问题（具有质量和能量衡算的反应器）、微分代数问题（汽液闪蒸/MESH方程）以及带回流的耦合多单元流程图。该基准包含十个问题：六个经典教材单元操作、一个更难层级（method-of-lines plug-flow reactor，即分布参数PDE；Van de Vusse多反应网络；以及具有NRTL活度系数的非理想闪蒸），以及一个未出现在任何教材中的程序生成反应网络。所有模型——前沿模型和本地模型——均在同一协议下评估：单一提示、无工具、无迭代修订，每项五个样本。出现两个发现。第一，在PROBE范围内，三个Claude模型（Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5和低成本Haiku 4.5）极其可靠：在全部十个问题的150次生成中（每个50次）我们未观察到失败；按three rule，在仅限于所评估模型和任务混合的汇总Bernoulli解释下，单次生成失败率的95%上限约为2%，并非可推广到未见过程建模问题的比率。这一结果同样在更难层级和程序生成网络中成立；值得注意的是，低价Haiku 4.5与旗舰模型一样可靠，因此这些任务上的前沿级性能可在低成本档位获得。Google Gemini 2.5 Flash也接近上限，只在非理想NRTL闪蒸和一个可复现的参数命名失误上下降，因此这种可靠性跨越两个供应商。这与基于裁判的基准所报告的情况不同，而新网络结果反对仅仅记忆的解释。我们谨慎地不宣称LLM已经“解决”过程建模：证据表明，在具有固定输入/输出契约的第一性原理单元操作上，当前前沿模型很少犯物理错误；这并非关于完整工业流程或自由形式建模的陈述。第二，正确性差距集中于较小、可本地部署的模型（3–14 B），而且它们的输出高度随机。尽管物理验证反馈循环可在单次对话中产生显著修正，但在匹配的生成预算下，我们在这项有限实验中没有证据表明它优于简单重采样并保留最高分候选物（配对Wilcoxon signed-rank：无显著差异）。这种比较因同一随机性而必不可少，随机性也使这类循环的单次运行评估具有误导性。在一项受控比较中，加入推理轨迹也未缩小差距：一个同尺寸开放推理模型的平均水平仅略高于其非推理对应物，仍因相同的契约命名失误而无法完成闪蒸；并且在某些困难问题上，它超过大量token预算进行推理却从未输出答案——这与能力而非反馈量或推理时计算量是这些模型限制因素的判断一致。

items.title: Agentic AI in Process Analytical Technology: LLM Assistants for Chemometric Workflows
items.abstract_or_text: Modern manufacturing in chemical and pharmaceutical industries increasingly depends on real-time analytical insight to maintain quality, safety, and flexibility. Yet, turning process measurements into actionable analyses still depends on scarce chemometric expertise and manual workflows. Herein, we adapt agentic AI to the process analytical technology (PAT) domain by developing PAT agents that combine large language models (LLMs) with validated open-source and commercial chemometric software, including RamanSPy, SpectroChemPy and PEAXACT, under a multi-agent orchestrator. We benchmark the agents on nine real-world Raman data-analytics tasks of varying complexity, across three user personas, and several LLM backbones. The PAT agents with frontier LLMs solve analytical tasks at 93–96% pass rate, while numerical claims are grounded in actual tool outputs, and are thus physically consistent and reliable. The agents translate individual user requests into adaptive analytical workflows, halt and request clarification on inconsistent inputs, and remain reviewable through structured logs of every tool call and state transition. These results establish PAT agents as transparent digital coworkers that expand access to advanced process analytics and support more adaptive, data-rich manufacturing, while expert chemometric oversight remains critical for industrial deployment.
items.summary_zh: 研究为过程分析技术开发PAT agents，将LLM与RamanSPy、SpectroChemPy、PEAXACT等化学计量学软件结合；在九项真实Raman数据分析任务中，前沿LLM版本的通过率为93–96%，并记录工具调用与状态转换。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该系统把大模型的任务编排与实际数值工具输出结合，针对化工和制药制造中的光谱分析有直接应用。基准任务数量有限，且工业部署仍依赖专家对数据质量、校准迁移和合规要求的审查。
items.abstract_zh: 化学和制药行业的现代制造日益依赖实时分析洞见，以维持质量、安全性和灵活性。然而，将过程测量转化为可操作分析仍依赖稀缺的化学计量学专业知识和手工工作流程。本文将智能体式AI适配至过程分析技术（PAT）领域，开发PAT agents；它们在多智能体编排器下，将大语言模型（LLM）与经过验证的开源和商业化学计量学软件结合，包括RamanSPy、SpectroChemPy和PEAXACT。我们在九项复杂度不同的真实Raman数据分析任务上，针对三种用户角色和多种LLM骨干模型，对这些智能体进行基准测试。使用前沿LLM的PAT agents在分析任务上达到93–96%的通过率，而数值性结论以实际工具输出为依据，因此在物理上保持一致且可靠。这些智能体将单个用户请求转化为自适应分析工作流程，在输入不一致时停止并请求澄清，并通过每次工具调用和状态转换的结构化日志保持可审查性。这些结果确立PAT agents为透明的数字协作者，可扩大先进过程分析的可及性，并支持更具适应性、数据更丰富的制造；同时，工业部署仍亟需化学计量学专家监督。
items.author_line: Jan G. Rittig, Luise F. Kaven, Philippe Schwaller

items.title: Causally-inspired meta-representation learning framework for predicting patient-specific clinical responses to drug combinations
items.abstract_or_text: Large-scale prediction and assessment of clinical patient responses (i.e., RECIST class) to drug combinations remains challenging due to scarce patient-derived data. The existing prediction methods mainly rely on cancer cell line models. However, substantial biological heterogeneity between cancer cell lines and cancer patients within same tissues, as well as the heterogeneity between one tissue and another, often limit the generalizability of these methods in clinical patients. To overcome these limitations, here we present CaMeRe, a Causally-inspired Meta-representation learning framework designed to predict patient-specific clinical Response to drug combinations. In situations where stable causal factors and domain-specific response-modulating factors are unobservable, explicit discrete domain labels are unavailable, and data is scarce, CaMeRe designed a domain-invariant causal representation learning (DICRL) model guided by the invariant information bottleneck theory and causal intervention invariance principle, and also built a meta-learning framework with bi-level domain generalization to optimize DICRL model for achieving multi-domain generalization within and across tissues. By integrating the causal representation learning and meta learning framework, CaMeRe not only exhibited robust multi-domain generalization performance across multiple clinical drug combination response datasets and PDXs drug combination response datasets and generalization scenarios, but also had better interpretability. We applied CaMeRe to predict drug-combination response scores for 3,423 patients across 542,080 drug combinations. The predicted scores were significantly associated with biomarkers of known drug combinations and enabled the prioritization of candidate drug combinations across 11 cancer types, with stronger support from literature and clinical trial evidences than random baselines. We believe that CaMeRe can be a useful tool for predicting large-scale clinical individual drug combination responses and it has broad clinical applications.
items.summary_zh: CaMeRe通过因果启发的元表征学习预测患者特异性联合用药反应，在多个临床和PDX数据集上进行泛化评估；模型为3423名患者的542080种药物组合预测反应评分，并在11种癌症中优选候选组合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它试图缩小细胞系与真实患者之间的异质性差距，并把组合疗法搜索推进到患者层面。因果稳定因素并未直接观测，临床关联和文献支持也不能等同于前瞻性疗效，仍需要独立临床验证。
items.abstract_zh: 由于患者来源数据稀缺，大规模预测和评估患者对药物组合的临床反应（即RECIST类别）仍具挑战。现有预测方法主要依赖癌细胞系模型。然而，同一组织内癌细胞系与癌症患者之间存在显著生物异质性，以及不同组织之间的异质性，往往限制这些方法在临床患者中的泛化能力。为克服这些局限，本文提出CaMeRe，一个因果启发的元表征学习框架，旨在预测患者特异性药物组合临床反应。在稳定因果因素和领域特异反应调节因素不可观测、明确离散领域标签不可获得且数据稀缺的情形下，CaMeRe设计了一个由不变信息瓶颈理论和因果干预不变性原则指导的领域不变因果表征学习（DICRL）模型，并构建了具有双层领域泛化的元学习框架，以优化DICRL模型，从而在组织内和跨组织实现多领域泛化。通过整合因果表征学习和元学习框架，CaMeRe不仅在多个临床药物组合反应数据集、PDXs药物组合反应数据集及泛化情形中表现出稳健的多领域泛化性能，而且具有更好的可解释性。我们应用CaMeRe为3,423名患者的542,080种药物组合预测反应评分。预测评分与已知药物组合的生物标志物显著相关，并可在11种癌症类型中优选候选药物组合；与随机基线相比，得到更多文献和临床试验证据支持。我们相信CaMeRe可成为预测大规模临床个体药物组合反应的有用工具，并具有广泛临床应用。
items.author_line: Zhang, Q.-Q., Zhang, S.-W., Shi, M.-H. 等 6 人

items.title: High-Throughput DNA Sequence Space Exploration for Carbon Nanotube Biosensor Design
items.abstract_or_text: Fluorescent single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) can be non-covalently functionalized with biopolymers such as DNA to create biosensors. Noncovalent functionalization promises a vast design space, but synthesis is limited by low-throughput dispersion steps. Here, we present a high-throughput SWCNT-based platform that utilizes covalent DNAanchor chemistry to recruit ssDNA recognition motifs via hybridization. The approach circumvents low throughput processing steps such as sonication or centrifugation. By integrating automated liquid handling and spectroscopy, we bypass traditional fabrication bottlenecks and synthesize 180 unique sensors and test 540 analyte/sensor conditions in less than three days. This accelerated workflow generates large datasets that are combined with an iterative machine learning (ML) pipeline. We demonstrate the versatility of this approach by evolving sensors with enhanced sensitivity for the neurotransmitter dopamine over common interfering molecules such as ascorbic acid in complex media. Through iterative rounds of ML-driven prediction and synthesis, we establish a scalable framework for rapid synthesis of functional nanosensors and increase the sensitivity for dopamine for up to 89 % of the evolved sensors. This strategy bridges the gap between the vast DNA sequence space and the generation of sensor variants, offering a scalable path to next-generation sensors.
items.summary_zh: 该平台以共价DNA锚定和杂交招募ssDNA识别序列，自动合成180种SWCNT传感器并测试540个分析物/传感器条件；结合迭代ML预测和合成，使多达89%的进化传感器对多巴胺的灵敏度提高。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把高通量化学制备、光谱测量和机器学习迭代结合，为DNA序列空间中的纳米传感器优化提供了真实实验数据。结果聚焦多巴胺及特定干扰物，复杂生物样本中的选择性、重复性和批间稳定性仍需进一步检验。
items.abstract_zh: 荧光单壁碳纳米管（SWCNTs）可通过DNA等生物聚合物进行非共价功能化，以构建生物传感器。非共价功能化提供了巨大的设计空间，但合成受制于低通量分散步骤。本文提出一种基于SWCNT的高通量平台，利用共价DNAanchor化学，通过杂交招募ssDNA识别基序。该方法绕开了超声或离心等低通量处理步骤。通过整合自动液体处理和光谱学，我们绕过传统制造瓶颈，在不足三天内合成180种独特传感器，并测试540个分析物/传感器条件。这一加速工作流程生成大型数据集，并将其与迭代机器学习（ML）流程结合。我们通过进化对神经递质多巴胺具有更高灵敏度、且能应对复杂介质中抗坏血酸等常见干扰分子的传感器，展示该方法的通用性。经由ML驱动预测和合成的迭代轮次，我们建立了一个可扩展框架，用于快速合成功能纳米传感器，并使多达89%的进化传感器对多巴胺的灵敏度提高。这一策略弥合了巨大DNA序列空间与传感器变体生成之间的差距，为下一代传感器提供可扩展路径。
items.author_line: Magdalena Theresia Kuom, Phillip Galonska, Sayantani Chakraborty 等 6 人

items.title: TRACER navigates rearrangement-driven sesterterpene chemical space via multimodal enzyme-product representation learning
items.abstract_or_text: Skeletal rearrangement drives the immense structural complexity of terpene, yet predicting it remains a formidable challenge due to sequence-function decoupling in terpene synthases. Here, we established TRACER (terpene rearrangement annotation via co-attentive enzyme-product representation), a multimodal framework mapping the latent associations between sequence-derived enzyme representations and product chemotypes. Retrospective validation proved TRACER's exceptional precision in predicting compound classes and discriminating skeletal rearrangement (SR) from non-skeletal rearrangement (NSR) pathways. TRACER-guided genome mining characterized two bifunctional synthases, FsPS and AcPS, uncovering four unprecedented carbon skeletons. Density functional theory calculations deciphered these cyclization cascades, pinpointing a critical 5/6/11 tricyclic intermediate as the key branching node for scaffold diversification. Mutagenesis and molecular dynamics simulations suggested that E305 in FsPS enables rearrangement by maintaining active-site water exclusion, whereas its alanine mutation causes premature carbocation quenching. Collectively, this work establishes a predictive paradigm for the rational discovery and mechanistic elucidation of complex terpene architectures.
items.summary_zh: TRACER通过酶序列表示与产物化学型的多模态协同注意力学习预测萜烯骨架重排；基因组挖掘发现FsPS和AcPS两种双功能合酶及四种未见报道的碳骨架，并以DFT、突变和MD分析其机制。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究将预测模型、天然产物发现和机理化学结合，给出了新骨架与关键残基的多种证据。模型的回顾性验证未给出外部前瞻发现率，且E305作用主要由模拟和突变推断，尚可借助更直接结构证据加固。
items.abstract_zh: 骨架重排造成了萜烯巨大的结构复杂性，但由于萜烯合酶中序列与功能脱耦，预测它仍是一项严峻挑战。本文建立TRACER（terpene rearrangement annotation via co-attentive enzyme-product representation），一个映射序列导出酶表示与产物化学型之间潜在关联的多模态框架。回顾性验证证明TRACER在预测化合物类别以及区分骨架重排（SR）与非骨架重排（NSR）路径方面具有卓越精度。TRACER引导的基因组挖掘表征了两种双功能合酶FsPS和AcPS，发现四种前所未有的碳骨架。密度泛函理论计算阐明了这些环化级联反应，确定一个关键的5/6/11三环中间体为骨架多样化的关键分支节点。突变和分子动力学模拟表明，FsPS中的E305通过维持活性位点水排除而实现重排，而其丙氨酸突变导致碳正离子过早淬灭。总体而言，这项工作建立了一个用于复杂萜烯结构合理发现和机制阐明的预测范式。
items.author_line: Xing, C., Lv, K., Zhang, W. 等 17 人

items.title: Assessing Codon Language Models for Context-Aware Codon Optimization in Nucleic Acid-Based Medicines
items.abstract_or_text: Codon optimization uses synonymous sequence changes to improve the expression and therapeutic performance of nucleic acid-based medicines. Masked language models (MLMs) have recently been proposed as alternatives to traditional, frequency-based codon optimization approaches, yet whether they offer a meaningful advantage over such simpler methods remains unclear. Here we benchmark three prominent MLMs --- CaLM, EnCodon and CodonTransformer --- across backtranslation fidelity, sequence generation and nine molecular phenotype prediction tasks, and experimentally evaluate model-designed sequences using a secreted embryonic alkaline phosphatase (SEAP) reporter. The models differed markedly in amino-acid fidelity and generated distinct synonymous sequence variants. However, no single model performed best across all benchmark tasks and simple sequence features remained competitive in several settings. Our interpretability analysis revealed that the models integrate a large window of codon context for making predictions, as opposed to frequency-based approaches. Our in vitro data showed that MLM-designed variants outperformed conventional and commercial vendor-derived sequences in both transient and stably integrated expression, supporting the models' ability to capture translational context beyond codon frequency. Together, our results establish MLMs as effective and complementary tools for codon optimization and suggest that sampling across multiple models may improve the likelihood of identifying high-performing therapeutic sequences.
items.summary_zh: 研究基准比较CaLM、EnCodon和CodonTransformer三种密码子MLM，并以SEAP报告基因实验测试模型设计序列；MLM变体在瞬时和稳定整合表达中优于常规及商业供应商序列。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作将蛋白语言模型的密码子优化与体外表达实验证据相连，并显示多模型采样的价值。不同任务没有统一最佳模型，报告基因结果也未充分代表各类核酸药物、递送环境和长期安全性。
items.abstract_zh: 密码子优化利用同义序列改变来提高核酸药物的表达和治疗性能。近期有人提出掩码语言模型（MLMs）作为传统基于频率的密码子优化方法的替代方案，但它们是否比这些更简单的方法具有实质优势仍不清楚。本文在回译保真度、序列生成和九项分子表型预测任务上，对三种重要MLM——CaLM、EnCodon和CodonTransformer——进行基准评测，并使用分泌型胚胎碱性磷酸酶（SEAP）报告基因对模型设计的序列进行实验评价。这些模型在氨基酸保真度上明显不同，并生成不同的同义序列变体。然而，没有单一模型在所有基准任务上均表现最佳，且简单序列特征在若干情形中仍具竞争力。我们的可解释性分析显示，与基于频率的方法相比，这些模型在作出预测时整合了大范围的密码子语境。体外数据表明，MLM设计的变体在瞬时表达和稳定整合表达中均优于常规序列和商业供应商来源序列，支持这些模型能够捕捉超出密码子频率的翻译语境。总体而言，我们的结果确立MLM为有效且互补的密码子优化工具，并提示跨多个模型采样可提高发现高性能治疗序列的可能性。
items.author_line: Toneyan, S., Scholz, K., De Donno, C. 等 7 人
